id.description:
Halo penggemar Momo, ini Ko So-young🍑

Hari ini, aku memperlihatkan ruang gantiku untuk pertama kalinya👗👜

Aku agak malu, tapi aku mengumpulkan keberanian karena aku ingin menunjukkan berbagai sisi diriku kepada kalian🤩

Aku akan terus menunjukkan lebih banyak sisi diriku melalui YouTube, jadi

mohon berikan banyak perhatian dan dukungan untukku🥰

Oh, dan aku telah menyiapkan event hadiah untuk kalian para penggemar Momo🎁✨

Mohon tunjukkan minat kalian! Terima kasih lagi hari ini💖

en-US.title: The reason Ko So-young deleted all her YouTube videos (confession of feelings)
en-US.description:
Hello everyone, this is Ko So-young.

You must have been surprised that no new videos were suddenly uploaded,

and that even the videos I posted over the past year had disappeared, right?

I took some time to reflect on who I am.

It feels like I have finally opened up to you all about myself,

and that I can finally feel relieved...

I am starting anew on the Ko So-young YouTube channel,

and I will do my best again!! We ask for your continued interest and love.

Thank you 🩷

#KoSoYoung #KoSoYoungYouTube #Confession
